title: The dog sleeps on it
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Page one on the bedroom floor overnight. The dog sleeps on it. In the morning it has a dog-shaped warmth and one paw print. Wood keeps the print. The novel now has a reader.

panels.composition: The bedroom floor, morning light. A sheet of lined paper. BARNABY asleep on it in the ammonite ball.

image.prompt: a small dog curled tightly asleep on a sheet of lined paper on a bedroom floor in morning light, black and white, no words

panels.composition: WOOD's hand lifting the dog's edge. The paper under him: warm, a paw print in the corner, mud.

image.prompt: close on a hand lifting a sleeping dog to reveal a muddy paw print on the corner of a sheet of paper, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Wood holding the page up. The print. The dog awake now, unbothered.

image.prompt: a young man holding up a sheet of paper with a paw print on it while a small dog yawns, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The page going into the box. Print and all. The strip shows the print going in, not the words.

image.prompt: close on a sheet of paper with a muddy paw print being placed into a cardboard box, the writing unreadable, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: The novel's first reader. The paw print stays in the box.
